cards.art: Wild-mustached philosopher smashing stone tablets with a sledgehammer
cards.name: NIETZSCHE
cards.power: Hammer of Transvaluation. Breaks stable fields to force new values.

cards.art: Sharp-eyed woman moving pawns on a tactical map table
cards.name: HANNAH ARENDT
cards.power: Civic Action / Power is created between people. / Can redirect conflict energy.

cards.art: Squat bald philosopher pestering armored warrior with a wine cup
cards.name: SOKRATES
cards.power: The Gadfly Stance. Traps enemies in dialogue loops. Enemies cannot attack until they define 'Virtue'.

cards.art: Grizzled cynic in barrel ignoring a glowing boss arena warning sign
cards.name: DIOGENES
cards.power: Radical Simplicity. Ignores all social status effects. Can sleep in Boss Rooms.

cards.art: Ancient sage holding skeleton keys with shadowed cave entrance behind him
cards.lore: Quest giver or manipulator? He wrote the simulation!
cards.name: PLATO
cards.power: Effect: Gives quest 'Leave the Cave'. Wants you to find Truth so he can rule.

cards.art: Formless figure wrapped in blankets with TV remote fused to hand
cards.lore: The ultimate Netflix and Chill! Nihilistic Cozy Mode unlocked!
cards.name: BOSS: THE LAST MAN
cards.power: Why struggle? Comfort is enough. Lesson: Progress generates resistance.

cards.art: Hammock-lounging ancient Greek figure buried in chip bags and glowing phones
cards.name: THE COMFORT TRAP
cards.power: Effect: Players must roll Willpower or lose a turn scrolling doom-feeds. Mechanic: 'Snack Distraction'. If a player eats a real-life snack, their character sleeps.

cards.art: Suited figure with monitor for a head presenting a wall of bar charts
cards.name: THE TECHNOCRAT
cards.power: Ability: Quantification. Replaces descriptions with bar charts.

cards.art: Bearded sage surrounded by floating pie charts with a holy data-glow halo
cards.name: THE DATA PRIEST
cards.power: Chant: 'Studies Show... Statistically Significant...' Effect: Anecdotal Evidence Rejected. Players cannot use personal experience.

cards.art: Pointing marble philosopher with two burning doorways behind him
cards.name: THE MORAL APOSTLE
cards.power: Effect: Binary Choice. Forces players to choose A or B. Both are bad.

cards.art: Single glowing pebble on stone floor surrounded by vast empty space
cards.lore: It does nothing. That is its power. It anchors you to reality. Use to defeat Ideals.
cards.name: THE PHILOSOPHER'S STONE

cards.art: Ornate Venetian mask fusing onto a warrior's face reflected in carnival mirror
cards.name: THE MASKED STAGE
cards.power: Effect: Players must swap their MOOD and SKILL chips here. Danger: If you enjoy the mask too much, you can't take it off. (IT BECOMES YOUR FACE!)

cards.art: Clockwork gears and prisms reducing human figures to clean geometric shapes
cards.name: THE FORMS ENGINE
cards.power: Effect: Idealization. Reduces complex reality to abstract concepts. Real humans burn up here.

cards.art: Massive blazing sun-entity looming over a tiny figure clutching a small pebble
cards.name: THE GOOD
cards.power: Mechanic: Cannot be fought. Can only be survived by holding the Pebble of Imperfection.

cards.art: Skeleton in deck chair holding a half-finished character sheet, hammock swaying nearby
cards.lore: Stay here. We can work on the character sheet forever.
cards.name: ETERNAL PLANNING
cards.power: Effect: Players gain bonuses for discussing feelings but cannot [act].

cards.art: Robed grey wizard holding three d20 dice with glowing runes, knowing smirk
cards.name: FRIZZLEBOB THE GREY THINKER
cards.power: Mechanic: The 3d20 Borromean Throw. Rolls for Cognition, Irony, and Uncertainty. Attack: Brain Bullet Time. The game slows down. You fight your own playstyle.

cards.art: Single grey pebble on white ground with NOT A PHILOSOPHER'S STONE scrawled beneath
cards.lore: Reality Check! NOT a philosopher's stone!
cards.name: THE PEBBLE
cards.power: Cancels Ideology. Forces concrete description of reality (e.g., 'The stone is cold').

cards.art: Sealed wax letter with emotional weight radiating from it, monster peeking from envelope flap
cards.lore: Heavy emotional baggage inside. Send it already!
cards.name: THE UNSENT LETTER

cards.art: Spinning compass needle going in all directions, grinning sailor on deck behind it
cards.lore: No North, only vibes. Lost but making good time!
cards.name: THE BROKEN COMPASS

cards.art: Elaborate gilded mirror showing a modern person staring back at a Greek hero
cards.lore: Break the fourth wall. Home sweet home?
cards.name: THE MIRROR OF ITHAKA
cards.power: Shows the player, not the character.

title: Plato's Dungeon Raids: The Odyssey Edition
